MOBILE BANKING STUDY

1. Don't you think mobile banking is really convenient?
2. We designed a new savings feature to help you save money. Do you like it?
3. Our data shows most users struggle with transfers. Is that a problem for you too?
4. We think the main issue is trust. Wouldn't you agree that trust is the biggest barrier?
5. We believe that our new interface is clearer than the old one. Is that true for you?
6. Why don't you use the budgeting tools more often?
7. We want to know whether our product is meeting your needs. Is it?
8. Our goal is to make banking faster. We expect users appreciate speed. Do you?
9. Don't you find the current navigation frustrating and awful?
10. Surely you would prefer to have everything in one place?
